name: dasel-cooperative-cancellable-decoding-with-22de
instr:
Dasel cannot currently cancel decoding cooperatively or report meaningful progress while preserving its synchronous reader API. Add context-aware decoding and carry the same context through command decoding and selector execution, without publishing incomplete values or output.

The `github.com/tomwright/dasel/v3/parsing` package must expose `DecodeStage`, `DecodeProgress`, `DecodeObserver`, `DecodeCanceledError`, `ContextReader`, `ReadContext`, and `Format.ReadContext`; `github.com/tomwright/dasel/v3/internal/cli` must expose `RunContext`. Every decode, including fallback for readers implementing only `Reader.Read`, must check cancellation before codec work and return nil with a `DecodeCanceledError` recognizable as the original context cause.

Observations must identify the registered format, start before completed work, advance nondecreasing completed-unit and in-range byte counts at codec-native safe boundaries, and end exactly once with success or cancellation, followed by nothing. Recursive JSON progress and complete-record CSV progress follow this contract despite measuring completed work differently. TOML and HCL publish native completed units.

Cancellation must be atomic across JSON recursion and multiple values, YAML documents and aliases, friendly and structured XML parsing and conversion, CSV records, TOML expressions and nested values, HCL bodies, INI sections, and KDL nodes. Cancellation at CSV record, XML conversion, and INI recursion boundaries returns no acc
